warning.titlePre: Mercedes Vito 114 CDI Injector Seal & Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your Vito 114 CDI is an early W447 model with the OM651 diesel engine — that's roughly 2014 to 2024 production — injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are a well-documented pattern on this engine. We replace injector seals, timing chain components and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

The current W447 refresh from 2025 onwards uses a different engine, the OM654, which doesn't share this specific issue — it's a newer design with its own characteristics. We still service it to the same standard as the OM651.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern (per G-BRF). OM654 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to early W447/OM651
